documentChunks.sectionTitle: Section 1: Global Time-Off Principles & Core Working Hours
documentChunks.text: Acme Global Technologies provides paid time off (PTO) to foster work-life balance and mental well-being. All regular full-time employees are entitled to standard statutory leaves in accordance with local labor jurisdiction, plus company-designated wellness flex days. Core working hours are defined as 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM local time.

documentChunks.sectionTitle: Section 2: Sick Leave and Compassionate Absences
documentChunks.text: Employees are granted 12 days of paid medical/sick leave per calendar year. A certified physician note is required for consecutive sick leaves exceeding 3 business days. Compassionate bereavement leave of up to 5 consecutive paid working days is provided for immediate family members.

documentChunks.sectionTitle: Section 3: Parental Leave and Caregiver Support
documentChunks.text: Primary caregivers are eligible for 20 weeks of fully paid maternity/parental leave. Secondary caregivers receive 8 weeks of fully paid paternity leave, which can be taken anytime within the first 12 months following birth or adoption.

documentChunks.sectionTitle: Section 4: Country Addendum — India (Statutory & Annual Leaves)
documentChunks.text: For all permanent employees based in India (Bangalore and Gurgaon development centers): Employees receive 24 days of Earned/Annual Leave per calendar year, accrued at 2.0 days per completed month of service. In addition, India employees receive 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave, and 10 declared National and Festival Holidays announced annually by People Operations. Up to 15 days of unused Earned Leave can be carried forward into the subsequent calendar year or encashed upon separation as per the Indian Factories & Shops Establishment Acts.

documentChunks.sectionTitle: Section 5: Leave Application Workflow & Manager Approval
documentChunks.text: All planned vacation requests exceeding 3 days must be submitted through the Acme HR Portal at least two weeks in advance. Line managers must review and approve or decline requests within 3 business days. Retrospective leave applications are only permitted for urgent medical emergencies.

All workforce accounts must enforce Hardware Security Key (FIDO2 / WebAuthn) or time-based one-time password (TOTP) multi-factor authentication. Passwords must be at least 16 characters long containing upper, lower, numerals, and special symbols, and must not match the last 10 historical passwords.

documentChunks.sectionTitle: Section 2: Mobile Device Management & Remote Wipe
documentChunks.text: Any personal mobile phone or tablet accessing Acme corporate emails, Slack, or GitHub must enroll in the Acme MDM profile. The Security Operations Center reserves the legal authority to remotely wipe corporate sandboxes or full devices immediately upon confirmed report of device theft, loss, or employee termination.

documentChunks.sectionTitle: Section 3: Data Classification & Encryption at Rest
documentChunks.text: All customer data and internal source code is classified as Confidential or Restricted. Production data stores must enforce AES-256-GCM encryption at rest with customer-managed keys (CMEK) and TLS 1.3 in transit. Production database credentials must never be committed to source code or stored in unencrypted client config files.

documentChunks.sectionTitle: Section 1: Service Mesh & Inter-Service gRPC Protocol
documentChunks.text: Synchronous internal microservice communication must standardize on Protobuf v3 contracts over HTTP/2 gRPC channels within the Istio service mesh. Mutual TLS (mTLS) with SPIFFE identity certificates is enforced at the sidecar level. Default RPC timeout is 2500ms with a maximum of 2 retries on idempotent status codes.

Each Node.js pod must allocate a maximum connection pool size of 15 connections to prevent exhausting primary cluster sockets during horizontal pod autoscaling (HPA). Connection idle timeout is set to 30 seconds. Redis sentinel clusters handle transient distributed locking and queue ingestion.

documentChunks.sectionTitle: Section 7: Incident Response, PagerDuty, and SLA Commitments
documentChunks.text: P1 Severity outages (API error rates > 2.5% for more than 5 minutes) page the tier-1 on-call engineer within 120 seconds. Post-mortem root cause analysis (RCA) blameless retrospectives must be published in Confluence within 72 business hours.
Acme Corporation has earmarked $45,000,000 for tuck-in acquisitions in enterprise search and RAG indexing infrastructure during Q3 2026. Target valuation multiples are capped at 8x forward ARR.

documentChunks.sectionTitle: CONFIDENTIAL: Global Enterprise Expansion & Revenue Targets
documentChunks.text: Projected Net New ARR target for FY2026 is $82,000,000 with a focus on financial services and defense compliance verticals.
